title: The Neurological Rehabilitation Centre at The Wellington Hospital

shots.description: An empty physiotherapy gym at the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre, with treatment couches, an exercise bike, balance trainers, gym balls and a dumbbell rack beside floor-to-ceiling windows. The camera glides past a blurred foreground object to reveal the room.

Camera moves past an out-of-focus monitor on a stand to reveal an empty neurological rehabilitation gym with treatment plinths, exercise bikes, chairs and a dumbbell rack beside floor-to-ceiling windows.

Empty rehabilitation gym in the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre at The Wellington Hospital, with a ceiling hoist track, dumbbell rack, exercise balls, treatment plinths and an exercise bike beside floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto trees. The camera moves through the room with much of the frame taken up by the ceiling.

An empty neurological rehabilitation gym at The Wellington Hospital with treatment plinths, exercise bikes, a dumbbell rack and chairs beside floor-to-ceiling windows looking onto trees. The camera moves slowly forward through the room.

An empty rehabilitation gym at the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre, with treatment plinths, an exercise bike, dumbbell racks, exercise balls and chairs beside floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking trees. The camera moves slowly across the room.

Camera tracks sideways past an out-of-focus pillar in the empty rehabilitation gym at The Wellington Hospital's Neurological Rehabilitation Centre, showing a recumbent exercise bike, chairs, a stool and treatment couches in the background. No people are in shot.

A camera move through the rehabilitation gym at The Wellington Hospital's Neurological Rehabilitation Centre, travelling past exercise bikes to a rack of dumbbells with gym balls behind. A treatment couch with pillows is visible in the background and no people are in shot.

Red and blue exercise balls and dumbbells sit beside two patient monitors on wheeled stands in an empty rehabilitation gym at The Neurological Rehabilitation Centre. The camera moves slowly across the equipment.
Racks of dumbbells, exercise balls and weight plates in the neurological rehabilitation gym, filmed with a slow sideways camera move past the equipment. No people are in the room.

Racks of chrome dumbbells, small coloured hand weights and blue and red exercise balls in the rehabilitation gym at The Neurological Rehabilitation Centre, The Wellington Hospital. The camera tracks slowly along the weight racks with no people in shot.

A staff member in a maroon tunic guides a patient in a white gown into an MRI scanning room and helps her sit on the scanner table. They chat and smile as she gets ready for her scan.
A radiographer in a maroon tunic helps a patient in a white gown lie back onto the table of a Siemens MRI scanner, guiding her with his hands as she settles into position.

A radiographer in a maroon tunic stands beside a Siemens MRI scanner and prepares a patient lying on the scanner table, covered with a blanket, for a scan in the imaging suite at The Wellington Hospital.

A radiographer in a maroon top positions a patient lying on the MRI scanner table and prepares them for a scan in an imaging suite.

In an MRI control room, a console monitor shows sagittal, coronal and axial brain scans being planned while a second Siemens monitor shows a camera view of a patient lying in the MRI scanner. The camera moves across the desk toward a staff member seated at the console.

A staff member in a maroon uniform types on a keyboard at a computer workstation with several monitors, shown in profile and in close views of his hands. Filmed at The Wellington Hospital's Neurological Rehabilitation Centre.

A staff member in maroon scrubs works at a computer workstation with monitoring screens, then the camera moves across to a seated person holding an acoustic guitar while a staff member in navy scrubs stands nearby in the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre at The Wellington Hospital.

A man holding a guitar sits on a chair beside patients in wheelchairs during a group session, likely music therapy, at the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre. A woman sits in a wheelchair in a rehabilitation therapy room. The camera tilts up from her feet to her face, past an out-of-focus person in the foreground holding a wooden object.

A music therapy session in the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre: a therapist plays acoustic guitar for two patients in wheelchairs while a staff member stands beside them. The shot moves in close on the guitar being strummed and fretted.

Close-up of a hand strumming a classical guitar during a music session in the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre at The Wellington Hospital. Other people sit blurred in the background, and one may be in a wheelchair.

A staff member carrying an acoustic guitar walks towards an older man in a wheelchair in a clinical room with sinks, ahead of a music therapy session. A second wheelchair user is partly visible behind them.

A staff member in a navy polo shirt plays an acoustic guitar and sings to a small group seated in the foreground, in a rehabilitation gym at The Neurological Rehabilitation Centre. Treatment plinths and folding screens are visible behind him, suggesting a music therapy session.

Low-angle tracking shot along a row of people seated in wheelchairs, showing their feet resting on the footplates and the chair wheels on a light-coloured floor in the Neurological Rehabilitation Centre at The Wellington Hospital.
